title: Tunnel-Toll Appraiser
text: Tunnel-Toll Appraiser values safe passage by listening to what moves beneath the floor. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The cheapest route is usually hungry.

defeatReward.text: Tunnel-Toll Appraiser is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
